title: 4 AI Agents Just Fixed Production Code With Zero Human Edits
tldr: A 4-agent loop (Planner, Patcher, Sandbox Runner, Shipper) found a real bug, patched it, tested it, and shipped it automatically.
The loop pattern — plan, patch, sandbox-test, ship — is what to copy, whatever stack you're on.

tools.name: Planner agent
tools.note: reads the failing function and scopes the fix

tools.name: Sandbox Runner
tools.note: runs the full test suite against the patch in isolation

tools.name: Shipper agent
tools.note: opens the PR and deploys once tests pass

steps.title: Point the Planner at the failing test
steps.detail: Give it the stack trace and the file, not just a vague bug description.

steps.title: Let the Patcher write one focused fix
steps.detail: One function at a time — smaller patches are easier for the sandbox to verify.

steps.title: Run the full suite in a sandbox before anything ships
steps.detail: Never let an agent push straight to production without this step.

steps.title: Only ship on a clean pass
steps.detail: If the sandbox fails, loop back to Patch — never force a merge.

tips: Keep each patch scoped to one function — multi-file patches are much harder for a sandbox step to verify safely.
mistakes: Skipping the sandbox step to save time — that's the step that actually makes this safe to automate.
